## Notes

- Job description and write paths: `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`issue_patch` for this post's title and PR bodies); route `dispatch` (relay); ⛔ no MCP write.
- Harness readings this fire: `check-harness-current.mjs` CURRENT at `18cd410dc4` after the post-merge fast-forward; four-axis block `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` lines 241–261 @ `d206d08cab`, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`, carried verbatim in the three dispatches.
- Platform readings this fire (r190's stand): `post-stamped` refuses a body that uses `{{NOW}}` and also carries a bare `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` anywhere, a backtick span included (`[mixed]`) — keep digits out of quoted spans or declare them in prose with `{{WAS:…}}`; `pr_request_reviewers` with two logins recorded two `review_requested` events, and `requested_reviewers` then listed only the login who had not yet reviewed — not a dropped request; `GET /repos/…/collaborators/{login}/permission` answers 403 to the seat's token; the REST job-log download (`…/actions/jobs/{id}/logs`) is refused by the container proxy (CONNECT 403 on the blob host) while the MCP `get_job_logs` read works and lands in a saved file to grep; a worker restart keeps the scratchpad, the shared checkout, the subscriptions and the Routine but makes finished subagents unreachable — their transcripts stay readable at `tasks/<id>.output`; relay `issue_patch` on a PR body stored byte-identical with 0 footers appended (second reading); an authorized approver may flip, arm and enqueue a Tier H PR by hand within minutes of the review request — the seat's landing stroke is then confirmation, not the flip.
- Review readings for the lane: a skills-step estimate in a dispatch is a mechanism assumption (the eleven-name list alone is 234 bytes; #23276's step cost ~204 tokens against a 60–100 guess) — give a budget, not an estimate dressed as one; `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:1296` and `turbo.json:762` declare `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` as an input of `@objectstack/rest`'s repo tests, and `packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` pins that skill as a teaching site of the meta state route — a `skills/**`-only diff can red `Test Core`; dispatches on that file say so.
- Timers and subscriptions: Routine `trig_01CRAqzBVfH5Bm9osRDWaPYB` (deleted at sign-off); no `send_later`; `subscribe_pr_activity` live on PR #23355, PR #23362 and PR #23366; PR #23257 and PR #23283 released at their merges; the PRs of #22978 and #23276 are subscribed when they open.
- Usage wall record (r190) stands; permission reading (r190) stands — `get_session` read `permission_mode: auto` after the restart.
